ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in the US
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud in the US, including the amount of money involved and the individuals and organizations responsible.
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud in the US?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and to hold those responsible accountable. It will require careful analysis of financial records and interviews with key sources.
